verdict.rationale: Qodo's core product generates AI insights and suggestions from the user's own code and PR data. Its documented features include severity-ranked findings that explain what needs attention, why it matters and how to fix it, along with one-click fixes, structured PR summaries, risk classification, and relevance scoring learned from the team's past pull requests. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of review insight quality, and deeper documentation of the portal-level codebase-health insights beyond a one-line mention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: every finding states what needs attention, why it matters, and how to fix it, ranked by severity
Discuss or dismiss a finding, or let Qodo apply the fix directly.
Relevance shows how likely a finding is to matter, based on how your team has handled similar findings in past pull requests.
Qodo automatically classifies the risk of a code change and can publish it as a native label in the pull request
See a complete history of findings, decisions, and codebase health.
